lines.zh: 我是一块立牌，移动靠人搬。
lines.en: I am a standee. Others move me.

lines.zh: 有人抓着我两边，抬起来走。
lines.en: Someone grips my edges and lifts me along.

lines.zh: 我的木座在地上拖出声音。
lines.en: My base drags noisily over the floor.
I am propped against a wall at an angle.
One push and cardboard slides a way.
I am carried down the steps.

lines.zh: 我的边角在门框上磕了一下。
lines.en: My corner knocks the door frame.
I am set beside the counter.
My position changes every day.

lines.zh: 风从门口进来，我晃了晃。
lines.en: Wind from the doorway makes me sway.

lines.zh: 我被转了个方向，面朝里。
lines.en: I am turned to face inward.
Then turned back to face outward.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙，棕色的纸面很平。
lines.en: I lie against the wall, my brown surface flat.
My hat is printed on.

lines.zh: 灯光从侧面打来，我有厚度。
lines.en: Light comes from the side; I have a thickness.
My bottom edge has curled a little.

lines.zh: 我一整天都是这个姿势。
lines.en: I hold this pose all day.

lines.zh: 有人从我面前走过，没有停。
lines.en: Someone passes without stopping.

lines.zh: 我背后的木头架子撑着我。
lines.en: A wooden frame holds me from behind.
The damp has softened my corners.

lines.zh: 我看起来比实际的玩偶新。
lines.en: I look newer than the real animatronic.
That is what printing does.
You stand in front of me. Perfect.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛是画上去的两个黑点。
lines.en: My eyes are two painted dots.

lines.zh: 你比我矮一点，从我这个角度。
lines.en: From here you look a little short.
I keep my smile forever.
You reach out and touch my hat brim.
That is paper, not cloth.

lines.zh: 你退开，我的视线还是朝前。
lines.en: You step back; my gaze still points ahead.

lines.zh: 我没法看你，只能朝前看。
lines.en: I cannot look at you. Only straight ahead.

lines.zh: 你走到侧面，我就成了薄薄一条。
lines.en: From the side I am only a thin strip.
You are laughing. I hear it.

lines.zh: 我的纸面被压出一道痕。
lines.en: A crease is pressed into my surface.
I go over and lie on the floor.
My paper edge has curled.
My base has come loose.

lines.zh: 我的印花剥落了一小片。
lines.en: A little of my printing has flaked.
Cardboard sounds brittle.
I am crooked and cannot stand.
My hat brim is bent.
My colors have faded again.
But I am still smiling.
I do not even have a stomach.

lines.zh: 你把食物举到我脸前，挡住了我。
lines.en: You hold food before my face and block my view.
Move it aside, please.

lines.zh: 那东西在我纸面上留了油印。
lines.en: It left a grease mark on my paper.
I have no hands to take it.
You set it at my feet.
Now it hides my base.

lines.zh: 我看不见它，但我知道它在。
lines.en: I cannot see it, but I know it is there.
I'm just a picture pasted on a wall.
I only want to stand quietly.
You touch me and I tip sideways.

lines.zh: 我斜靠在墙上，没有完全倒。
lines.en: I lean on the wall without falling flat.
My base makes a knock.

lines.zh: 纸板撞人不疼，只是吓人。
lines.en: Cardboard does not hurt. It startles.
A crease forms at my edge.
You set me upright. I am grateful.
I am blocking the aisle. Sorry.
My shadow lies across your feet.
You squeeze past me.

lines.zh: 我的纸面被你的衣服蹭响了。
lines.en: Your clothes rasp against my paper.
I am only printed matter.

lines.zh: 这里还有一块，跟我一样。
lines.en: There is another one here, just like me.
Someone set us side by side.
Even our angles match.

lines.zh: 我们不会说话，也没有话要说。
lines.en: We do not speak, and have nothing to say.
Over time our colors fade together.
That counts as company, I suppose.

lines.zh: 风把我们吹得朝同一边。
lines.en: The wind leans us the same way.
Tomorrow we may be separated.
I do not mind at all.
I cannot hold anything.

lines.zh: 东西掉在我脚边，被挡住了。
lines.en: It falls at my feet and is hidden.

lines.zh: 有人踢到了它，我才知道。
lines.en: Someone kicks it, and only then do I know.
I cannot see below.

lines.zh: 它卡在我的木座和墙之间。
lines.en: It is wedged between my base and the wall.

lines.zh: 如果没人来找，它会一直在这儿。
lines.en: If no one comes for it, it stays.

lines.zh: 我记住了它落下的声音。
lines.en: I remember the sound of it landing.
It was light, like paper.
Perhaps printed too.
That is all I can think of.
You stand in front of me.

lines.zh: 我的视线固定在你身上。
lines.en: My sight is fixed on you.
I will not move, and I will not blink.
This is how I lock on.
My base presses the floor.

lines.zh: 玻璃纸面反着你的影子。
lines.en: My glossy surface reflects your shape.
Are you going to strike me?

lines.zh: 印刷的领结，被雨水泡软了。
lines.en: My printed bow tie is soft from rain.
Break me and nothing bleeds.
But someone will come to replace me.
That one will not be printed.

lines.zh: 我立在游戏厅门口，斜着。
lines.en: I stand crooked at the arcade door.

lines.zh: 你走近时，我的影子斜过来。
lines.en: As you come closer, my shadow leans in.
My smile is frozen.
That will not change.
Now you are right before me.
I face you without turning.
You go left and I lose you.
You return, and I see you again.
I have no other motion.
My shadow moves with the light.
The light is behind me and the shadow reaches you.
It touches you before I could.
Cardboard does not strike.
My presence is the reminder.
A reminder of what is here.
You have stepped back three paces.
My gaze still falls where you stood.
My angle will not change.
So do not move either.

lines.zh: 纸板上的我在笑，不会眨。
lines.en: The painted me smiles and never blinks.
Until someone comes to move me.
Or until you leave.
I can wait for either.
You have walked off.
I cannot see you anymore.
I cut with my paper edge.
There is a pale line on your finger.
It is all I can do.
I am pushed over and fall against you.
Cardboard is light, but loud.
I startled you.
That counts as a strike, I think.

lines.zh: 我的木座翻了，磕到你的脚踝。
lines.en: My base tips and knocks your ankle.
You dodged it.
I lie on the floor, face up.
The ceiling has many cracks.

lines.zh: 我以前没从这个角度看。
lines.en: I never saw it from this angle.
Someone stands me up.
I face forward again.
That blow is already forgotten.
I break quickly, and am replaced as quickly.
I cannot remember for long.
Do not take it to heart.
My smile is still in place.
That much will not change.

lines.zh: 我被立在柜台旁，面朝门口。
lines.en: I am stood by the counter, facing the door.
My base is set squarely.

lines.zh: 有人退后两步看了看，点头。
lines.en: Someone steps back, looks, and nods.
They think I am placed well.

lines.zh: 灯照在我，我的影子落在墙上。
lines.en: The light is on me; my shadow falls on the wall.
This room is very quiet.
There is no dust on my paper yet.
This place has just opened.

lines.zh: 有人从门口进来，看了我一眼。
lines.en: Someone comes in and glances at me.
He walked around me.
That is quite good.
I am standing right here.

lines.zh: 火从我的下角往上卷，纸边发黑。
lines.en: Fire curls up from my lower corner, blackening the edge.

lines.zh: 我从柜台上掉下去，正面砸在地上。
lines.en: I fall from the counter and land face down.

lines.zh: 水从底下渗上来，我的纸面起了皱。
lines.en: Water seeps up from below and my paper wrinkles.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀飞，纸片散了一地。
lines.en: The blast flings me up and my paper scatters.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过去，留下一个圆孔。
lines.en: An arrow passes through, leaving a round hole.

lines.zh: 光打在我身上，印花在动。
lines.en: Light strikes me and the printing shifts.

lines.zh: 潮气一直不散，我的纸越来越软。
lines.en: The damp will not lift and my paper softens.

lines.zh: 雷落下来，我的边缘焦了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my edges char.

lines.zh: 我飘起来，纸面在黑暗里翻。
lines.en: I drift up, my surface turning in the dark.
